# Price the job by what actually drives the hours.

> Free bid calculator for independent licensed land surveyors: price a boundary, topographic, or ALTA/NSPS survey by corners located vs. set, terrain, record research, crew and drafting time — and see the gap against a flat per-acre quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
